result.question: Why does Abimelech ask his armor-bearer to kill him?

readings.answer: To prevent people from saying that a woman killed him.
readings.support: lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’

readings.answer: Because a woman had crushed his skull with a millstone.
readings.support: a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.

assessments.reason: The passage states his motive explicitly: “lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him,’” which matches “to prevent people from saying that a woman killed him.”
While the woman’s millstone injury precedes his request, the text gives his stated reason as reputation (“lest they say … a woman killed him”), not merely the injury itself.

result.reason: Verse 9:54 explicitly gives Abimelech’s reason: to avoid people saying a woman killed him.
